Host-board layout (REFERENCE HOST BOARD LAYOUT sheet 2: the plan view shows B and OB fingers = the board face the part sits on; VIEW A-A shows A and OA fingers = the other face, drawn mirrored in x: A_k lies directly under B_k). Own face = B/OB (ordinary pads), far face = A/OA (opposite pads); ASSUMPTION: the print does not say which face is top, the plan view is taken as the own face. Fingers 0.35 wide, 1.46 to 2.96 above the board edge (GH datum), i.e. 1.5 long, centre 2.21 above the edge. Pad x from the pad centre line FH: B28 +2.005 ... B1 +18.205 (27 spaces 0.6 = 16.2), B29 -2.005 ... B42 -9.805 (7.8), B43 -14.715 ... B70 -30.915 (16.2); OB14 +22.6 ... OB1 +30.4 (7.8). Origin = housing centre = centre of the two M2 screw holes (CH): CH is 0.26 left of FH (CL OF CH / CL OF FH, 0.26), so x = x(FH) + 0.26. Screw holes dia 2.4 (2PLC) 67.96 apart (31.42 + 30.9 to the additional-pad edges + 2 x 2.82 half pad = 34.24 and 33.72 from FH), 3.23 above the board edge; drawn as non-plated 2.4 holes (the "additional pad (no soldering)" copper 5.64 x 5.05 min and the dia 4.2 keep-out are not drawn: the hole is not centred in the pad). Housing 73 x 14.55 (sheet 1), 12.15 from the screw-hole centre to the front edge (so 2.4 behind the hole): housing front edge 12.15 - 3.23 = 8.92 beyond the board edge, rear edge 5.63 inside it, centre 1.645 beyond the edge. Footprint y = (distance beyond the board edge) - 1.645: the board edge is at y = -1.645, the host board lies toward -y, the housing overhangs toward +y; pad centres at y = -2.21 - 1.645 = -3.855, screw holes at y = -4.875. The card is mated perpendicular to the board (section C-C), so no in-plane card entry direction exists.

Pads 28X 1.2 x 0.35, 14 per row, pitch 0.6 (13X 0.6); A1..A14 lower row, B1..B14 upper row (leader lines), A1/B1 at the right end: d from the datum Y line: A1 = B1 = 13.46 (printed 13.46), A14 = 13.46-13x0.6 = 5.66. Rows +-2.3 from the centre line (4.05 = 1.75 + 2.3 printed). Plated slots 4X drill 1.1 x 2.45 (detail A), lands 1.4 x 2.75 (reference dims): d = 0.02, 2.24, 14.80 (13.46 + 1.34 printed), 16.55 (scaled), y = 0. Peg dia 1.1 (non-plated assumed) at (3.80, +1.75) (3.80 = 1.71 + 2.09 scaled; the printed 11.75 spans the round hole at d=1.71). The print draws a second peg at (13.46, -1.75) (printed 13.46 and 1.75) whose circle overlaps the B1 and B2 pads by 0.6 mm (its centre is on the inner end of the B1 pad): NOT DRAWN, because the library loader rejects a hole overlapping a numbered pad. Plated holes dia 1.1 (land 1.4 assumed) at y = -4.2 (scaled; printed 2.44 and 1.74 around it): d = 1.71, 3.73, 13.05, 15.08 (scaled). NOT DRAWN: the two dia 1.1 holes drawn inside the slots at (1.71, 0) and (15.01, 0) (they overlap the slots: unclear in the print); three more pad outlines drawn at the left end of each row (outside the 28X count) are not contacts. Origin x = midpoint of the outer slots (d = 8.285); housing 15.53 max (sheet 1) x 6.5 (assumed), y = centre line.

footprints.description: TE Sliver 2.0 receptacle, vertical SMT, 168 contacts (2391643)
footprints.note: TE drawing 2391643 (customer drawing, rev A), datasheets/connector-card-edge/te/2391643.pdf, sheet 2 RECOMMENDED PCB LAYOUT AND KEEP OUT AREA with detail G. Pads 168X 1.4 x 0.35, pitch 0.6; per row 14 pads (13X) from d = 1.825 (OA1/OB1..OA14/OB14), 28 pads (27X) from 14.02 (A1..A28), 14 from 34.23 (A29..A42), 28 from 46.94 (A43..A70) (printed 1.825, 14.02, 34.23, 46.94), d from the datum Y line; numbering left to right; A/OA upper row, B/OB lower row (leader lines). Rows at +-2.42 from the centre line (printed 4.17 = 1.75 + 2.42). Plated slots 5X drill 1.1 x 2.45, lands 1.4 x 2.75 (reference dims of the sibling prints): d = -1.55, 11.86, 32.23, 44.49, 66.52 (printed), y = 0. Round holes dia 1.1: (0, +1.75) and (64.97, 0) (64.97 printed) non-plated (plating not stated). The pin names of this part (A1..A70, B1..B70, OA, OB) follow the print labels. Origin x = midpoint of the outer slots (d = 32.485), y = centre line; housing 69.32 max (sheet 1) x 6.5 ("(6.5)").
